mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contest_attempt WHERE contest_id = #{contestId}

SELECT attempt_id, contest_id, user_id, problem_id, attempt_seq, submit_id, kind, accepted_at, state, judge_status, score, correct, completed_at FROM contest_attempt WHERE submit_id = #{submitId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE contest_attempt SET state = #{state}, judge_status = #{status,javaType=com.anishan.commons.enumeration.JudgeResult,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.handlers.MybatisEnumTypeHandler}, score = #{score}, correct = #{correct}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE submit_id = #{submitId} AND state = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contest_attempt WHERE contest_id = #{contestId} AND state = 'PENDING'
SELECT COALESCE(submit_id, attempt_id) FROM contest_attempt WHERE contest_id = #{contestId} AND state = 'PENDING' ORDER BY attempt_seq ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(a.submit_id, a.attempt_id) FROM contest_attempt a LEFT JOIN submit_log sl ON sl.submit_id = a.submit_id LEFT JOIN contest_records cr ON cr.contest_id = a.contest_id AND cr.user_id = a.user_id AND cr.problem_id = a.problem_id WHERE a.contest_id = #{contestId} AND ( (a.kind = 'OJ' AND ( a.submit_id IS NULL OR sl.submit_id IS NULL OR sl.contest_id <> a.contest_id OR (a.state = 'PENDING' AND ( COALESCE(sl.result_applied, 0) <> 0 OR LOWER(COALESCE(sl.status, '')) NOT IN ('queue', 'compiling', 'running') )) OR (a.state = 'COMPLETED' AND ( COALESCE(sl.result_applied, 0) <> 1 OR LOWER(COALESCE(sl.status, '')) IN ('queue', 'compiling', 'running', 'judge_error') OR NOT (sl.score <=> a.score) OR cr.record_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(cr.applied_attempt_seq, 0) < a.attempt_seq OR (COALESCE(cr.applied_attempt_seq, 0) = a.attempt_seq AND (NOT (cr.score <=> a.score) OR NOT (cr.status <=> a.correct))) )) OR (a.state = 'INFRA_ERROR' AND ( COALESCE(sl.result_applied, 0) <> 1 OR LOWER(COALESCE(sl.status, '')) <> 'judge_error' )) )) OR (a.kind = 'NON_OJ' AND ( a.state <> 'COMPLETED' OR a.submit_id IS NOT NULL OR a.score IS NULL OR a.correct IS NULL OR cr.record_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(cr.applied_attempt_seq, 0) < a.attempt_seq OR (COALESCE(cr.applied_attempt_seq, 0) = a.attempt_seq AND (NOT (cr.score <=> a.score) OR NOT (cr.status <=> a.correct))) )) OR a.kind NOT IN ('OJ', 'NON_OJ') ) ORDER BY a.attempt_seq ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT sl.submit_id FROM submit_log sl LEFT JOIN contest_attempt a ON a.submit_id = sl.submit_id AND a.contest_id = sl.contest_id WHERE sl.contest_id = #{contestId} AND a.attempt_id IS NULL AND (COALESCE(sl.result_applied, 0) = 0 OR LOWER(COALESCE(sl.status, '')) IN ('queue', 'compiling', 'running')) ORDER BY sl.submit_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
